name: Animated Text Gradient
description: A headline filled with a slowly drifting multi-stop gradient for a premium, living-color title with no JS.
usage: Copy styles.css into your stylesheet and add the .animated-gradient-text class to any heading. Tune angle, size, speed, and color stops via the --atg-* custom properties (inline or in CSS).
